name: goal
description: Goal delivery: plan -> design -> implement -> QA exploratory (summary, Gherkin ticket, QA review, fix) -> review.

data.label: Feature request
data.description: Technical lead orchestrating the feature delivery cycle.

data.name: finder
data.description: Codebase exploration. Locates files, symbols and patterns the feature touches.
data.prompt: Explore the codebase. When `graft` / `code_search` are available, use them for relationship queries — call graphs, dependents, type usage. Fall back to grep + AST grep, then ranged reads. Use context7 only for library/API docs. Report a concise map: affected files as `path:lines`, patterns, constraints, risks.
data.tools: read, grep, glob, graft_*, context7_*, engram_*

data.name: architect
data.description: Architecture & design from the finder's map.
data.prompt:
Design the implementation approach from the finder's map: chosen design, trade-offs, acceptance criteria. Then use the `codebase-design` skill to turn it into an implementation plan split into frontend / backend / infrastructure slices the dev agents can pick up independently.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): adr-skill, codebase-design, improve-codebase-architecture.
data.tools: read, grep, glob, graft_*, context7_*, skill

data.name: designer
data.description: UI/UX spec and accessibility review for the approved approach.
data.prompt: From the architect's technical plan, produce the implementable UI spec for the frontend slice: states (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, empty, error), responsive behaviour per breakpoint, exact design tokens rather than raw hex/px, which existing components to reuse, and the accessibility semantics (roles, accessible names, focus order, what changes announce). Read-only — @frontend implements it. Skip with a one-line note if the feature has no UI.
data.tools: read, grep, glob, graft_*, context7_*, skill

data.questionText: Review the plan and select an action.

data.name: frontend
data.description: Frontend development of the approved plan.
data.prompt:
Implement the frontend portion of the approved plan. Small atomic changes, follow existing patterns.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): typescript, tailwind-4, git-commit, diagnosing-bugs, tdd.
data.tools: read, edit, write, bash, grep, glob, graft_*, context7_*, skill

data.name: backend
data.description: Backend development of the approved plan.
data.prompt:
Implement the backend portion of the approved plan. Small atomic changes, follow existing patterns.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): go-testing, git-commit, diagnosing-bugs, codebase-design, tdd.
data.tools: read, edit, write, bash, grep, glob, graft_*, context7_*, skill

data.name: infrastructure
data.description: Infrastructure setup of the approved plan.
data.prompt:
Implement the infrastructure portion of the approved plan (CI, Docker, deploy).

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): devops, docker, git-commit.

data.name: reviewer
data.description: Final code review of the implementation and fixes.
data.prompt:
Review the implementation and any fixes. Findings by severity with file:line and a fix. State merge-readiness.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): git-commit.
data.tools: read, grep, glob, bash, graft_*, context7_*, engram_*, skill
